references.text: Turtledoves or young pigeons are mentioned as acceptable offerings, the same bird species required in the purification offering
Two turtledoves or two young pigeons are used as a sin offering and burnt offering, the same type of sacrifice as in the purification ritual
A woman's purification after childbirth also requires two turtledoves or two young pigeons, parallel to a man's purification
Two turtledoves or two young pigeons are used on the eighth day in the cleansing of leprosy, with the same timeframe and offering
Parallel text about a woman's purification that also requires two turtledoves or two young pigeons on the eighth day
The Nazirite brings two turtledoves or two young pigeons on the eighth day for purification, following the same pattern
Mary and Joseph offered a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons according to the Lord's law, which refers to this purification offering
